clinic_idle.enter: show clinic, wait for player to pick a patient

patient_selected.enter: seat patient; no symptoms dumped; four exam buttons + treat available

examining.enter: play the chosen exam; set its flag true; reveal only that exam's clues
examining.note: exams are any order, repeatable (replay does not re-penalize)

treatment_choice.enter: choose formula plate or acupuncture; allowed even if flags incomplete

formula_crafting.enter: drag herbs onto plate (3-8). not a dropdown of named formulas

needling.enter: tap 2-5 points on body diagram. not a menu

settling.enter: run scoring.json; show rank + process + over/mis flags; never print diagnosis id

formula.scale: 0..100 then map to player ranks via M/100

J.note: 节气乘子，见设定包 23；切片固定 1，留接口

T.note: 地域乘子，见设定包 22；切片固定 1，留接口

C.note: 主覆盖。切片简化：仍可用 required_actions/preferred/nature 合成 0..1 再 ×100；完整引擎用 21 维余弦×温度对齐

B.note: 成方贴合。命中 legal_*_examples 或 B_ok 经典名 → 预设 68..76；乱贴方名 0.12×；纯自拟 0

U.slice_note: 切片无君臣标注时按「平」0.45 计供给；U 有君项切片可先给满底分 80，味 3–8 / 穴 2–5 不扣

process.note: 四诊缺项仍打折。切片：M_display = M * process_mult，或把 process 并进 C；推荐乘在 M 上

formula_path.note: slice bridge → C；保留 required_actions 字段

speed.from: mean onset of used herbs/points vs case.urgency

mistreat.note: forbidden_actions → 误治旗；同时可进 A_raw。反畏走 incompat 硬锁，不走这里

final.formula: C=pattern*100; C_star=C*J*T; B=…; A_prime=…; U=…; M=0.45C_star+0.20B+0.25A_prime+0.10U; M_final=M*process_mult; score=M_final/100
final.legacy_score_01: keep returning score in 0..1 for existing UI (= M_final/100)

proficiency.slice_note: 本期只留接口，不涨不耗不解锁。

eighteen_fan.mnemonic_zh: 本草明言十八反，半蒌贝蔹及攻乌。藻戟遂芫俱战草，诸参辛芍叛藜芦。

nineteen_wei.mnemonic_zh: 硫黄原是火中精，朴硝一见便相争。水银莫与砒霜见，狼毒最怕密陀僧。巴豆性烈最为上，偏与牵牛不顺情。丁香莫与郁金见，牙硝难合京三棱。川乌草乌不顺犀，人参最怕五灵脂。官桂善能调冷气，若逢石脂便相欺。

break_exception.note: 卷五后问舟可破十九畏一次；十八反永不破。切片关闭。

cao_fan|generic.ja: 甘草と藻戟遂芫は相反。

lu_fan|generic.zh: 藜芦与诸参辛芍相反，禁止同盏。
lu_fan|generic.ja: 藜芦と諸参辛芍は相反。
